hallmark.reason: Useful macrostructure-first and design-DNA/reference-study ideas. Its stylistic heuristics are not universal project truth; direction.md internalizes the useful principle.

gstack-design-shotgun.reason: Useful concrete-variant comparison and selection workflow. The full stack is too broad/opinionated to become a default dependency.

gpt-taste.reason: Aggressive anti-default influence. The routable taste-v2 entry is bounded; generic doctrine is not loaded as a second simultaneous builder.

codebuff-evalbuff.reason: Useful influence for baseline-vs-candidate outcome evaluation and ablation. Harness evaluation belongs in evals/, not the runtime protocol.

anthropic-generator-evaluator.reason: Supports fresh evaluator separation near capability/subjective boundaries while showing evaluator overhead can be unnecessary on simpler work.

ui-craft.reason: Useful craft-system reference, but its opinionated doctrine/global scoring is not core.

emil-kowalski-skills.reason: Useful motion-purpose/frequency/interruption/reduced-motion guidance; numeric recipes are not universal rules.

garden-skills.reason: Useful grounding/design-context ideas; mandatory checkpoints/recipes are too workflow-heavy.

tastemaker.reason: Useful real-pixel grounding/continuity concepts; competing memory system and large gate set are not adopted.
